channel.title: LIWFY
channel.description:
This channel is run by a dedicated editing team.

Every video goes through its own curation and editing process, always 
respecting the licenses and permissions of the original material.

We don't do simple reuploads. Each clip is cut, re-assembled, and paired 
with original on-screen text commentary, phonk soundtrack, cuts, 
transitions, and effects — resulting in a new piece with its own identity.

The editing process takes around 1 to 2 hours per video, depending on the 
complexity of the cuts and the sync with the soundtrack.

Multiple different clips are combined and manually worked on until they 
form a single video with editing and commentary exclusive to this channel.

Questions, credits, or removals: x.fael@outlook.com
We reply to every message as soon as possible ❤️

#shorts #phonk #edit #viral
